rationales: Laboratory preparation is not manufacturing on an industrial scale.
Micro-scale preparation produces only small quantities.
Industrial chemistry manufactures compounds on a commercial scale.
Domestic-scale preparation is not the meaning of industrial chemistry.
A proton is charged and is less penetrating than a neutron.
An electron is more penetrating than an alpha particle but less than a neutron in this comparison.
A neutron has high penetrating power because it has no electric charge.
An alpha particle has low penetrating power because it is relatively massive and charged.
Lattice energy is associated with forming an ionic solid from gaseous ions.
Ionization energy is the energy needed to remove an electron from an atom.
Electronegativity is an atom’s tendency to attract shared electrons in a bond.
Electron affinity is the energy released when an electron is added to an atom.
Mendeleev’s postulate did not provide the basis for the long-form table.
The long-form periodic table is arranged according to increasing atomic number.
Atomic mass was the basis of Mendeleev’s original periodic table.
Mass number is not the basis of the long-form periodic table.
Donation of electrons is characteristic of forming a cation, not a covalent bond.
Acceptance of electrons is characteristic of forming an anion, not a covalent bond.
A covalent bond involves sharing electron pairs between atoms.
Repulsion of electrons does not form a chemical bond.
Nitrogen in NH₃ has a complete octet and a lone pair.
Boron in BF₃ has only six electrons around it, making the molecule electron deficient.
Each nitrogen atom in N₂ has an octet through the triple bond.
Each oxygen atom in O₂ has an octet in its Lewis structure.
O₂ and Cl₂ have nonpolar bonds between identical atoms.
N₂ has a nonpolar bond, so this pair does not both have polar covalent bonds.
H₂O has polar bonds, but C₂H₂ is not a clear example of a polar covalent molecule.
Both H₂O and HCl contain polar covalent bonds.
Blockage of light is not the cause of the Tyndall effect.
The Tyndall effect does not occur because light passes without scattering.
The Tyndall effect is caused by scattering of light by colloidal particles.
Passing through without scattering would not make the beam visible.
Hydrogen is oxidized and oxygen is reduced when water forms, so it is a redox reaction.
The reaction is not an acid–base reaction.
No acid and base react to form salt and water, so it is not neutralization.
Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water, so this is not decomposition.
Sodium does not react directly with nitrogen under ordinary conditions, unlike lithium.
Sodium can react directly with hydrogen under suitable conditions to form sodium hydride.
Sodium can form compounds with carbon under suitable conditions.
Sodium reacts with phosphorus to form a phosphide.
Butter is a gel-type colloid in which liquid is dispersed in a solid medium.
Air is a gas-in-gas mixture, not a liquid-in-solid solution.
Brass is a solid solution of solids, chiefly copper and zinc.
Alcohol in water is a liquid-in-liquid solution.
Liquids are generally much more than 100 times denser than gases.
Liquids are approximately 1000 times denser than gases in the usual textbook comparison.
A density ratio of 10000 is too large for the stated general comparison.
A density ratio of 100000 is far too large for the stated general comparison.
Starch dispersed in water can form a colloid.
Paint is also a colloid, so this is another correct option.
Milk of magnesia is generally treated as a suspension rather than a colloid in this classification.
Chalk in water is a suspension, not a colloid; however, both starch and paint are colloids, so the question has multiple correct options.
Tin can corrode, but rusting specifically refers to iron corrosion.
Aluminium corrodes by forming an oxide layer, not rust.
Rusting of iron is the most common example of corrosion.
Zinc corrodes but does not form iron rust.
Sodium is soft and is not the most malleable metal among these choices.
Iron is malleable but less so than gold.
Gold is the most malleable metal among these options.
Potassium is soft and is not the most malleable metal among these choices.
